name: WAVEOFFENSE
notes:
The Wave Offense focuses on spreading the defense and then blocking them with bigger bodies. Personnel are as follows:

The Bellcow: Fullback is the primary runner again, as intended.
The Scatback: The Running Back meant to get the ball out wide behind blockers and make plays
The Wideback: The Slot Receiver that can run crisp routes, but also act as a screen runner
The Wide End: The primary Medium-Deep receiver that can double as a Tight End and Wide Receiver
